verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents the response schema. It does not say transcripts come back as JSON with utterances or segments, or that they include confidence values. The adjacent items (diarization, per-channel transcripts, CLI output-format switching, an OpenAPI spec existing) do not describe structured utterance or confidence output, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, results come back as structured JSON with utterances or segments and confidence values, not just a text blob
